item.title: Hitachi Beef: Ibaraki's Premium Wagyu — Guide
item.description: Hitachi beef (Hitachi-gyu) is Ibaraki’s premium wagyu brand, raised on the prefecture’s rich pastureland under strict quality standards that govern feed, breeding and grading. Known for its fine, even marbling and tender texture, the beef is served across the prefecture in dedicated steakhouses, yakiniku grill restaurants and traditional sukiyaki and shabu-shabu establishments, offering a genuine taste of high-grade Japanese wagyu outside the more famous Kobe or Matsusaka brands. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Various towns across Ibaraki Hours Lunch & dinner, restaurant-dependent Admission Set meals typically ¥3,000–8,000+ Time needed 1–1.
